public_surface.imports: Python standard library only; controller.py, backend.py, simulator.py, prior controllers, and candidate-v12-through-v21 runtime code are not imported

report.valid_meaning: The supplied terminal evidence is internally exact and independently reopenable under this contract. valid does not convert CONTROLLER_INVALID, STOPPED_AFTER_DRAIN, VALID_SUBJECT_FAIL, synthetic, or canary evidence into qualification credit.

custody.bundle_rows: exact sorted successor-relative path, SHA-256, and byte-count rows recomputed from live files
custody.synthetic: WORKTREE_EXACT_BUNDLE with launch Git HEAD recorded as data; later current-HEAD equality is not required because the exact run-bound live bundle is independently recomputed and compared
custody.actual: GIT_HEAD_PINNED at launch; reopen requires run.git_head to resolve as an existing commit and every exact live bundle file to equal its blob at that recorded historical commit; unrelated worktree dirt and later commits are ignored
custody.historical_reopen_report: custody records the recorded head, exact-live-bundle result, recorded-commit-blob result, and historical_head_reopen PASS without treating that status as qualification credit

repaired_regression.predecessor: iteration_002 rejects an otherwise valid synthetic historical-head witness solely at RUN_GIT_HEAD_DRIFT
repaired_regression.successor: iteration_003 accepts the same unchanged exact-bundle witness; actual custody instead reopens every bundle blob from the recorded run.git_head commit
repaired_regression.fail_closed: Malformed or missing recorded commit, missing blob, or blob/storage byte drift is invalid.

causal_rules.attempt_causal_inputs: exact sorted references by kind, id, path with storage SHA-256 and bytes
causal_rules.cell_eligibility: every declared prior cell is an exact durable PASS completion and every declared stage artifact is exact before attempt creation
causal_rules.stage_eligibility: declared boundary cell and all direct cells are exact PASS and all predecessor stages are exact
causal_rules.stage_storage: manifest-declared insertion-order minified expected_artifact plus exactly one LF
causal_rules.subject_fail: first valid FAIL permanently stops that slot; no later same-slot attempt, raw result, completion, or artifact may exist
causal_rules.controller_invalid: global stop, exact receipt and terminals, zero qualification credit
causal_rules.clean_matrix: 291 exact PASS completions and exactly 54 eligible route-local stage artifacts including S90 for all three routes

checks: exact expected interface and direct-child nonlink run root
semantic v2 manifest, pipeline contract, inventory receipt, routes, schedule, frozen source hashes and bytes
exact 16-row live controller backend verifier semantic and paired-inventory bundle
run kind, mode, custody, route, selected slot-major schedule, row identity, and unique predeclared nonce
create-only row directory inventory and provider_input.txt exact frozen storage and provider-visible bytes
attempt causal_inputs exact sorted refs with no missing, extra, duplicate, future, failed, or mutated input
backend closed terminal, route, nonce, provider bytes, task/thread/turn, poll, output, raw rollout, and prohibited-activity evidence
deterministic insertion-order exact-output score and completion-last chain recomputation
stage eligibility, total order, exact path, payload, payload hash and bytes, storage hash and bytes
no post-first-FAIL same-slot evidence and no post-controller-invalid global evidence
exact path terminals, matrix terminal, clean-matrix bar, and accounting
global cross-run task, thread, turn, and nonce freshness across the evidence root
nonclaims: No provider, subject, or network call is made.
No evidence is written, repaired, deleted, renamed, resumed, or relaunched.
No recursive or self-hosting verifier authority is granted.
No private-helper, reflection, callback-confinement, capability-token, or hostile in-process caller threat is pursued.
A valid synthetic run remains zero-credit development evidence.
Verifier validity is not a candidate, audit, freeze, canary qualification, production readiness, release readiness, or safety certification claim.
residuals: A final filesystem snapshot verifies exact bytes and causal closure but cannot independently reconstruct historical O_EXCL or fsync system calls; those remain trusted-controller obligations.
